verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Doha's West Bay area, with views of the Arabian Gulf, West Bay and the adjacent Pearl Island.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Doha boasts an elite address in the city’s celebrated West Bay area with views of the glittering Arabian Gulf, West Bay, and adjacent Pearl Island.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is near Katara Cultural Village.
verified_facts.excerpt: with views of Pearl Island and proximity to Katara Cultural Village

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a collection of sixteen restaurants and cocktail bars.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience an extraordinary collection of sixteen international and award-winning Doha restaurants and cocktail bars

verified_facts.text: Hakkasan at the hotel is a modern Cantonese fine dining concept founded in London.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hakkasan is a modern, award-winning Cantonese fine dining concept, founded in London

verified_facts.text: Vilebrequin La Plage is a beachfront restaurant celebrating the flavors of Provence.
verified_facts.excerpt: This Doha restaurant celebrates the flavors of Provence through light dishes served in inspiring beachfront settings.

verified_facts.text: Guerlain designed spa rituals exclusive to The St. Regis Doha, including 'Waves of sand' and 'Pearl of Doha'.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guerlain has designed rituals that are exclusive to the St Regis Doha. “Waves of sand” and “Pearl of Doha”, are two unique experiences inspired by the magic of the Orient.

verified_facts.text: All guest room and suite bookings include St. Regis Butler Service.
verified_facts.excerpt: All guest rooms and suite bookings includes butler service.

verified_facts.text: The Kids Learning Center offers drawing and coloring, tailored educational lessons, music and outdoor adventures.
verified_facts.excerpt: Children will engage in a spectrum of enriching activities, from unleashing their creativity through drawing and coloring, gaining insights with tailored educational lessons, exploring their musical talents, and enjoying outdoor adventures.

verified_facts.text: Children must always be accompanied by a parent, guardian or nanny in the Kids Club facilities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Children must always be accompanied by a parent, guardian, or nanny while using the Kids Club facilities.

verified_facts.text: Guests have access to both a private beach and a pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, guests enjoy both a private beach and pool.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool overlooks the Arabian Gulf.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Olympic pool offers guests a luxurious and tranquil space to relax and unwind, overlooking the Arabian Gulf Sea.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor padel court.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stay active at the fitness center and outdoor padel court, then unwind with bespoke spa treatments.

verified_facts.text: Guests can ride jet skis along the hotel's private beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests are invited to embark on an exhilarating jet ski escapade along the hotel's private beach

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms are marble with a deep soaking tub and a separate rain shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spacious marble bathrooms feature a deep soaking tub and separate rain shower.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have neo-classical decor with a blue carpet and silk drapery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy neo-classical decor with a plush blue carpet and silk drapery.

verified_facts.text: The afternoon tea is inspired by Caroline Astor.
verified_facts.excerpt: A luxury Afternoon Tea in Doha inspired by Caroline Astor, featuring seasonal pastries, refined savories, and signature desserts crafted for an elegant experience.

verified_facts.text: Athar is a regenerative initiative with Al Fardan Corporation that turns the hotel's organic waste into compost for local farms that supply its kitchens.
verified_facts.excerpt: We transform organic waste into nutrient-rich compost for local farms, which in turn supply our kitchens with fresh produce.

verified_facts.text: During Ramadan, select dining venues are closed during daylight hours and guests can gather at the Asateer Ramadan Tent.
verified_facts.excerpt: select dining venues remain closed during daylight hours. We invite you to gather at the Asateer Ramadan Tent

verified_facts.text: Hamad International Airport is approximately 23 kilometers from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: DOH is located approximately 23.0 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: Astor Grill offers the St. Regis sabrage ritual with its classic cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy curated wines, and classic cocktails from our cocktail bar in Doha with the St. Regis sabrage ritual.

verified_facts.text: Vine's Friday brunches pair global dishes with live music.
verified_facts.excerpt: Friday brunches pair creative global dishes with live music.

verified_facts.text: The Engine Room combines a love of classic cars with cigars.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Engine Room allows you to experience the interweaves between the love for classical cars, warm ambiance and sophisticated taste of cigars.

verified_facts.text: Private poolside cabanas are inspired by Vilebrequin's Riviera style, with dedicated service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in a private poolside cabana inspired by Vilebrequin’s Riviera style, featuring dedicated service, shaded comfort, and exclusive access

verified_facts.text: Families can book a desert safari to the south of Qatar with professional drivers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Journey to the South of Qatar where professional drivers will host you and your family on an exciting desert adventure.

verified_facts.text: The Empire Suite has two bedrooms, living and dining rooms, and 180-degree sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Welcome to the spacious Empire Suite, an epitome of luxury with two bedrooms, stylish living and dining rooms, and 180 degree breathtaking sea views.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Doha.
